Rebuild with the native feature enabled.'. (b) Test 2 (arg_and_clap_precedence_without_native_diagnostic) exercises 6 clap error/conflict cases (Catalog cases 18..=23: compile-missing-out, prove-missing-required, simulate-trace-conflicts-logical-cap, simulate-resume-conflicts-target, verify-intent-cap-conflicts-profile, global-quiet-verbose-conflict) returning clap exit code 2 without mori::command::native-unavailable, and 4 argument-only semantic precedence cases (Catalog cases 24..=27: simulate-trace-missing-target, intent-signed-profile-missing-at, intent-signed-profile-missing-target, verify-intent-signed-profile-missing-target) that include all required ActionInput/authority/signature/at companions to pass clap parsing and trigger the pre-native semantic refusal (exit code 1, empty stdout, expected substring in normalized stderr, and no mori::command::native-unavailable). The 13-entry environment whitelist excludes HOME, RUSTFLAGS, and wrappers; the 4 tool binaries in TOOL-METADATA.json and the metadata-only absence of all 14 ancestor Cargo config paths in CARGO-CONFIG-METADATA.json are rechecked prior to spawn. The prior 12-test CLI admission is not reused, and those 12 tests are not needlessly re-run.
limitations: Unchanged sentinel tree snapshots, error precedence checks, and static source inspection do not prove the absence of read-only filesystem syscalls (such as openat/stat) by the child process; no strace or I/O interception seam is used.

The candidate test target is currently UNRUN; prospectiveTree 4565d96b056990e808605f7a2a53519a29e311f4 must be committed with that exact git tree hash before the single 90s+5s attempt, and the actual execution logs/results require a fresh independent non-author result audit before merge.
/usr/bin/timeout enforces only wall-clock (90s TERM + 5s KILL grace) on the top-level command and does not enforce aggregate child memory (RAM), disk quota, or cgroup/process-group resource bounds.
